title: GCP NEXT 2016: Day 1 Keynote (Mar 23)
summary: The day one keynote of Google Cloud's 2016 GCP NEXT conference, with Sundar Pichai, Diane Greene, Eric Schmidt, Urs Holzle and customers. It includes a Cloud ML demo by Jeff Dean.
why: HN cites it as evidence of Google's cloud commitment and for Jeff Dean's talk-and-code demo.

quote.text: I was on edge of my seat as I watched him talk and code things up at the same time.
